problems.title: Continuous Subarray Sum
problems.desc: Read N and K on the first line, followed by an array of N positive integers. Find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size K.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.desc: Read two space-separated lowercase strings. Print YES if the second string is an anagram of the first string, otherwise print NO.
problems.ht:
rat car
---
NO
===
triangle integral
---
YES

problems.title: The Bounded Auctioneer
problems.desc: Read N (number of items) and B (budget). Then N lines follow with Cost C[i] and Profit P[i]. Output the maximum possible profit without exceeding budget B.

problems.title: Longest Non-Repeating Substring
problems.desc: Read a single string S. Print the length of the longest substring containing no repeating characters.

problems.title: Minimum Bid Adjustments
problems.desc: Read N and M. Then M lines follow describing directed edges (u v weight). Output the shortest travel path from node 1 to node N. Output -1 if node N is unreachable.
